requirements.text: GET /api/owners/1 as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 200 JSON with id 1 and firstName George when owner 1 exists.
GET /api/owners/2 as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 404 when owner 2 is not found.
GET /api/owners?lastName=Davis as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 200 JSON with exactly owners id 2 Betty and id 4 Harold in that order.
GET /api/owners?lastName=0 as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 404 when the filtered owner collection is empty.
GET /api/owners without lastName as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 200 JSON with exactly owners id 2 Betty and id 4 Harold in that order when the service supplies them.
GET /api/owners without lastName as OWNER_ADMIN returns HTTP 404 when the complete owner collection is empty.
POST /api/owners as OWNER_ADMIN with all five valid OwnerFields returns HTTP 201.
POST /api/owners as OWNER_ADMIN with firstName missing returns HTTP 400.

test_cases.title: Existing owner is returned

steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 application/json with id 1 and firstName George.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The existing owner is returned with the source-backed fields.

test_cases.title: Missing owner returns not found
preconditions: ClinicService returns no owner for id 2.
test_cases.expected_outcome: No owner body is accepted as a success response.

test_cases.title: Last-name filter returns matching owners in order
preconditions: ClinicService returns Betty Davis id 2 followed by Harold Davis id 4.

steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 JSON array with [id 2, firstName Betty] then [id 4, firstName Harold].

test_cases.expected_outcome: Exactly the two supported Davis owners are returned in order.

test_cases.title: Empty last-name filter returns not found
preconditions: ClinicService returns an empty collection for lastName 0.
test_cases.expected_outcome: An empty filtered collection is reported as not found.

test_cases.title: Unfiltered list returns supplied owners in order
preconditions: ClinicService returns Betty id 2 followed by Harold id 4.

steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 JSON array with [id 2, firstName Betty] then [id 4, firstName Harold].

test_cases.expected_outcome: Exactly the two supplied owners are returned in order.

test_cases.title: Empty owner list returns not found
preconditions: ClinicService returns an empty complete owner collection.
test_cases.expected_outcome: An empty complete owner collection is reported as not found.

test_cases.title: Valid owner is created

steps.action: POST /api/owners with all five OwnerFields as JSON.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The valid owner request is accepted as created.

test_cases.title: Owner without first name is rejected

steps.action: POST /api/owners with firstName omitted and the other required fields as JSON.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Validation rejects the incomplete owner request.

warnings: Credential safety — generated automation must use @WithMockUser OWNER_ADMIN and must not persist real credentials.
Bounded scope — only eight owner read/list/create variants are in this run.
